reviews.text:
Went in to prepare for the arrival of a new kitten and the staff couldn't have been more helpful.

Very knowledgeable on everything they have in stock and even offered to order things in especially and hand deliver them to us.

Will definitely go back whenever we need anything for pets.

What incredible service from the team today. I had frozen mice turn up a day late completely defrosted from one of the bigger suppliers I won’t name here and after back and forth all week was fed up and looked local (should’ve started there) needless to say within hours of placing my order through the contact form and a quick call with the store team my frozen mice were on their way for even less than I’d paid before. Hand delivered with a smile! Cannot thank you lot enough for the efficiency and friendly service. You guys are my go to’s now. 10/10
Really good pet shop with friendly and knowledgeable staff, always helpful 👍 …

Great customer service with the sort of knowledge and experience only found from a small family business.
Friendly and helpful
Recommend highly

Prices here are surprisingly good, especially for a shop right on the Broadway. They carry a huge range of treats and toys that keep my dog very happy. Everyone who works here is friendly and clearly loves animals.
Customer Service the best! thank you for helping me with fleas. Great prices, good location, lots of products.
Went to this pet shop my god! It’s smells like a dead body it stinks in here flies everywhere no wonder there are no animals in there💀 …
